result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.delete_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Delete an edge from the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L777-L865){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.delete_edge(source=None, target=None, id=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Remove edges by specifying either the source and target nodes, or the edge ID directly. For multigraphs with source/target, only the first matching edge is deleted. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str, None]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Source node ID or label. Required if `id=` is not provided. [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str, None]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Target node ID or label. Required if `id=` is not provided. [id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Edge ID to delete. If provided, `source=` and `target=` are ignored. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If no edge exists matching the criteria. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If neither (`source`, `target`) nor `id` is provided. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Delete edge by source and target: ::: {#79eee3f9 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .delete_edge(source="A", target="B") ) # Edge no longer exists graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Delete edge by ID: ::: {#e97fcf83 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) edge_id = graph.get_edge_ids()[0] graph.delete_edge(id=edge_id) # Edge no longer exists graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: :::
